findings.title: ResourceQuota is exhausted
findings.cause: StatefulSet kd-statefulset-claim-quota/db cannot create PersistentVolumeClaim data-db-0 from its volumeClaimTemplates, so the pod that mounts it is never created: ResourceQuota storage is used up (requested requests.storage=1Gi, used requests.storage=0, limit requests.storage=100Mi)

evidence.detail: Create Claim data-db-0 for Pod db-0 in StatefulSet db failed error: persistentvolumeclaims "data-db-0" is forbidden: exceeded quota: storage, requested: requests.storage=1Gi, used: requests.storage=0, limited: requests.storage=100Mi

evidence.command: kubectl get resourcequota storage -n kd-statefulset-claim-quota -o jsonpath='{.status}'

findings.fix: Raise ResourceQuota storage, lower the storage the volumeClaimTemplates ask for, or delete claims that hold the quota (a StatefulSet keeps its claims after its pods are gone).
